name: scorm-kit
description: Parse SCORM 1.2 / 2004 (3rd, 4th Ed) packages from Articulate Rise 360, Storyline 360 or plain HTML into an LLM-ready kit and build pages from it. Runs offline.

interface.longDescription: Reads SCORM 1.2 and 2004 (3rd/4th Edition) packages from Articulate Rise 360, Storyline 360 or plain HTML SCOs, and recovers every lesson, block, image and quiz answer key. Exports instructions.md, per-unit markdown, questions with answer keys, assets and a viewer page, so you can rebuild the course as an HTML page, a quiz bank, slides, a job aid or a summary. Refuses SCORM 1.1, 2004 2nd Edition, AICC, xAPI and cmi5 with a reason instead of guessing. Runs offline: no network calls, no data collected.
defaultPrompt: Turn this SCORM course into a one-page HTML microlearning page
Make a quiz bank CSV with answer keys from this course
What is inside this SCORM package?
